source.referenceAudioUsage: Development-time measurement only. No reference audio is loaded by src/grand-piano.js or copied into procedural output.

method.alignment: independent causal 3 ms RMS onset detection; comparisons use time relative to onset
method.spectrum: 25 ms post-onset Hann windows; reference L/R power averaged; adaptive 32768–131072 FFT; SFZ tune applied to reported reference frequencies/centroids
method.onsetShape: RMS in 0–5, 5–10, 10–20, 20–40, and 40–80 ms frames, normalized to each signal maximum
method.decay: 50 ms RMS windows starting 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, and 1.4 seconds after onset, normalized at 0.02 seconds
method.partials: first up-to-12 locally resolved partial powers below 15.5 kHz, normalized and clipped at -60 dB
method.caveat: These gain/phase-invariant proxies measure convergence of behaviors, not waveform identity or perceptual equivalence to the recorded Yamaha C5.

checks.name: complete SFZ sustain grid is compared
checks.target: 480 recordings = 30 sampled pitches × 16 velocity layers; all stereo PCM16/44.1 kHz

checks.name: synthesized fundamentals converge across every sampled pitch and velocity
checks.proxy: Local FFT peak includes unison beating, so it is stricter than nominal oscillator tuning.

checks.name: synthesized pitch stays near the SFZ-retuned recorded pitch
checks.target: gap median <= source residual +3 cents; gap p90 <= source residual +4 cents
checks.proxy: The synth target is equal-tempered pitch. Residual retuned-reference offsets (especially weak bass fundamentals and C8) establish the attainable comparison floor.

checks.name: onset-to-peak timing converges over the full grid
checks.proxy: Causal 3 ms RMS timing measures macroscopic buildup; sampled-key modal peaks vary by more than 40 ms, so the five-frame shape check is the stricter transient criterion.

checks.name: five-frame onset energy shape converges
checks.proxy: Normalized 0–80 ms RMS shape is gain-invariant but omits spatial cues.

checks.name: broadband brightness stays in the same perceptual neighborhood
checks.proxy: Centroid is sensitive to microphones and action noise; cents express a frequency ratio, not pitch error.

checks.name: normalized partial-energy profiles converge
checks.proxy: Partial-band MAE captures harmonic structure while ignoring phase and stereo radiation.

checks.name: 0.02–1.45 second energy trajectories converge
checks.proxy: Fixed RMS windows expose two-stage loss and beating but are affected by reference noise floors.

checks.name: within-note velocity/dynamic curves converge
checks.target: dynamic MAE median <=5 dB/p90 <=8 dB; dynamics correlation >=0.9; brightness correlation >=0.95; >=95% endpoint-direction agreement
checks.proxy: Curves are independently normalized at layer 16; SFZ playback gain is not reconstructed.

checks.name: no bass/middle/treble bucket hides a severe transient or decay failure
checks.target: each register transient p90 <=14 dB, decay p90 <=20 dB, and partial-profile p90 <=22 dB
checks.proxy: Bucket limits prevent a strong global median from masking an entire weak register.

checks.name: every velocity layer preserves convergence across the sampled scale
checks.target: 16/16 layers × 30 pitches; centroid rank >=0.9; 400 ms decay rank >=0.7; partial median <=10 dB; onset median <=5 dB
checks.proxy: Rank correlations test register-scale behavior without demanding sampled-key phase or room identity.
